column1: # Catherine: Full Body (0100BC4010896000), the Korean / Chinese release: Atlus's GFD engine (xrd758) on SDK 8.2.1, NVN, with CRI middleware (CPK archives, ADX2 sound, Sofdec2 movies through the SDK's movie library).

# Brought up on a Legion Y700 (TB322FC, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16) on 2026-11-17: the boot, the title with its puzzle type choice, the anime opening with its sound, the Golden Playhouse, the first Nightmare stage's difficulty and puzzle type menus, its cutscenes and its block puzzle (the gameplay screen), at a held 30 fps as on the Switch (the game's present interval 2), with no red line. The playthrough is not checked yet (the stick, the pause menu, a save, the text entry), so the port is experimental.

# The constants are the ones the profile of the 1.0.1a release (0100BF00112C0000) found: the 4 GB layout, the 96 MB of used memory, the five CPK archives and the two shaders the game compiles at boot with its own GLSLC. This release's own build row and its shader tables are its own (main differs from 1.0.1a; the GLSLC, the movie library and the SDK are the same builds, so the two run-time shaders are the same).

# What it needed from the core: a picture's time that moves when the game's own does not (dm/android/movie_avc.c: a player that advances its clock with the picture's time stops feeding the decoder when the picture it shows does not move, and the anime intro froze on its first frame; the game's own times are kept otherwise, as a stream with B-frames needs them), the end-of-stream flag on an output without a picture (dm/host/hle_movie.c: CRI Sofdec2 drops a picture flagged end-of-stream and then waits for it, so the movie ended on a black screen), and the run-time shader capture on the device (#344), whose outputs the shader split reads.
